style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist modular component assembly on a pale laundry-room shelf, split-screen diptych with left-right scenario contrast. Left half: a wall-mounted smart-home hub with a small mechanical call counter and a short grey ethernet cable; right half: a deck-of-cards brushed-aluminum box with two serial ports, a stubby Bluetooth antenna, a 3.5mm audio jack and a power-over-ethernet socket, resting on a small rubber mat. A washing machine is softly out of focus behind the shelf. One directional key light rakes from the left; palette bone white, graphite, deep pine green. Viewed through a 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, no text, no logos.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random letters, watermarks, unreadable lettering, legible numbers, UI, logos
rationale: The story turns on a single pricing gate and a physical port, so a restrained split-screen modular assembly makes the metered cloud hub and the deck-of-cards serial box directly comparable. Clean edges, matte materials, and a long cast shadow give the comparison the weight of a technical drawing while staying legible at card size.

subject: wall-mounted cloud meter and deck-of-cards serial-port box on a laundry-room shelf
core_thesis: The interface a home device answers through—metered cloud calls or a one-time physical port—now sets its running cost, not whether it works with the hub.
core_conflict: cloud-metered subscription path vs one-time local hardware port

review.depicts: A split-screen diptych in a laundry room: on the left, a small off-white wall-mounted box with a serial connector and a trailing cable hangs on the side of a light-wood cabinet, and on the right, a small metal box with an antenna, two serial ports, an audio jack and a network port sits on a dark mat on a wooden shelf, with a blurred white washing machine visible behind each half.
review.reason: The diptych shows exactly the article's two protagonists — a cloud-side meter-like box and a one-time physical-port box beside a washer — so a reader would recognize the story's port-versus-cloud mechanism.
